scoring_justification: The checker compares predicted phase leads to hidden observed values; recomputing the full diffusive interface model is not feasible in the verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Observed phase lead values for each experiment (gold table)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the paper's experimental results table
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are actual published experimental measurements; using them ensures comparison against genuine scientific data.

outputs.description: Predicted phase lead (distance between alpha and beta lamellar tips) in micrometers for each of the eight experimental conditions. Positive values indicate beta leads, negative indicates alpha leads.

output_contract.notes: The predicted phase leads are compared to the paper's observed phase leads (hidden) for classification into coupled and noncoupled regimes. Scoring tolerances account for implementation differences in the numerical model.
